capabilities: Show a copy icon in the top-right of a fenced code block while it is being edited
Copy the code contents without the fence lines
Flash a checkmark when the copy succeeds
Hide the button when the cursor leaves the block so the built-in control returns
extras: Desktop only (no mobile), requires Obsidian 1.8.0 or later, and has no settings. Limited to Live Preview and fenced code blocks (~~~ and ```); indented code blocks and Source mode are not supported.
intentEvidence: Obsidian shows a language label and copy control on a code block when the cursor is outside it
problem: In Live Preview, Obsidian hides the code block copy control as soon as the cursor is inside the block, so you cannot copy while editing.
summary: Copy-button helper that keeps a copy icon visible on fenced code blocks while you edit them in Live Preview.
